notes.title: First Major bug fixes (Your saved game will be broken)
notes.notes:
Major bug fixes that I've been able to find with the help of some players of Apacies, these include:
Issues with saving- and also expanding saving to have 3 slots for multiple games.
Fixing menus (especially the Apacies upgrade menu)- to be more user friendly and less overwhelming
And various other quality of life changes.

This update makes Apacies: Creature of the Old West that much more intuitive and fun.
Thank you all very much, have a wonderful night.

notes.title: Apacies Release Date: August 20th!
notes.notes:
It's been a long process, with many hurdles along the way. But In the next month you should be able to see Apacies in full. (Patreon members will all be gifted a key to the game if they have contributed for more than 3 months)

I'm in the middle of crunch for Apacies, finishing story and getting small flourished ready for the final release. As I can see the final product on the horizon, I want to announce the release date of August 20th. It might not be the goal of Feb 14th (Arizona's birthday) like I had wanted, but It will be nice to celebrate the beloved Father Kino on his birthday.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44693437/f7189763e1a2ef656534ad324f4fda68a7dfcf23.png

I will be streaming an Ask-Me-Anything and playing Apacies on it's release date on Twitch (https://www.twitch.tv/direphon). I hope to see you all there.

This has been a wonderful learning experience, and I know I will be able to look back on this project with fondness and pride.
